name: Menu / Account Menu
description: Account Menu product scenario for the Menu component.

controls.name: children
controls.description: The trigger: one element that takes the trigger props and ref, or text shown as a Button; without it nothing renders.

controls.name: items
controls.description: Items, separators and labelled groups in menu order; an item repeating an earlier value is dropped.

controls.name: openOn
controls.description: Opens on a click of the trigger, or on its context menu at the pointer. Default click.

controls.name: open
controls.description: Controlled visibility; a disabled Menu, or one without a trigger, stays closed.

controls.name: defaultOpen
controls.description: Visibility on mount when `open` is not set; read once.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Disables the trigger and closes an open menu.

controls.name: surface
controls.description: Where the menu opens: auto is a popover, or a bottom sheet below 900px.

controls.name: side
controls.description: Preferred side of the trigger for a click menu's popover; flips when the opposite side has more room. Default bottom.

controls.name: align
controls.description: Alignment of a click menu's popover on the cross axis, following the trigger's direction. Default end.

controls.name: sideOffset
controls.description: Gap in pixels between the trigger and a click menu's popover; negative values overlap them. Default 4.

controls.name: attachmentSelector
controls.description: Nearest ancestor used for a click menu's left/right attachment; --uf-dropdown-panel-gap measures the painted surface gap. Vertical alignment still follows the trigger.

controls.name: alignToOption
controls.description: Aligns a measured visible row opposite the trigger on left/right surfaces; usually `[role^="menuitem"]`. Context menus ignore it.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Names the menu and titles the sheet; without it a click menu is named by its trigger.

controls.name: labels
controls.description: Strings Menu renders itself: `close` names the sheet's close button.
